records.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT 2026
Thistlewick Property Management. Lease number TPM-3B-2026.
1. Parties. This lease is between Thistlewick Property Management ("Landlord") and Alex
Rivera ("Tenant").
2. Premises. 1847 W Tamsin Ave, Unit 3B, Chicago, IL 60622, including storage locker 3B and
use of the shared laundry room.
3. Term. January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026.
4. Rent. $1,620 per month, due on the 1st of each month. Rent paid after the 5th of the month
incurs a late fee of $50.
5. Security deposit. The security deposit of $1,200 paid under the prior lease dated March 1,
2025 carries over to this lease. The deposit will be returned within 30 days of move-out, minus
the cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear and tear, with an itemized list of any
deductions.
6. Utilities. Tenant pays electricity and internet. Landlord pays water, gas and trash.
7. Maintenance and repairs. Tenant reports repairs through the resident portal. Landlord makes
repairs within a reasonable time. Emergencies (no heat, flooding, a gas smell) may be reported
by phone at any hour.
8. Entry. Landlord may enter the premises with 48 hours' notice for repairs and inspections, or
without notice in an emergency.
9. Alterations. No painting, wallpaper or structural changes without the Landlord's written
approval.
10. Subletting. Tenant may not sublet the premises or assign this lease without the Landlord's
written approval.
11. Noise. Quiet hours are 10 PM to 8 AM.
12. Pets. Tenant may keep one cat or one dog under 40 pounds with prior written approval from
the Landlord. A non-refundable pet fee of $300 is due before the pet moves in. Exotic animals
are not permitted.
13. Parking. One assigned outdoor space, number 14, at $75 per month.
14. Smoking. Smoking is not permitted anywhere in the building.

15. Renewal and notice. Either party may end this lease at the end of the term with 30 days'
written notice. If Tenant stays after the term without a new lease, the tenancy continues month
to month at the same rent.
16. Move-out. Tenant returns all keys and key fobs on the last day and gives a forwarding
address for the deposit refund.
Signed: Alex Rivera, Tenant, December 10, 2025
Signed: Dana Whitfield, for Thistlewick Property Management, December 10, 2025

Weeknight turkey chili (serves 4)

1 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic
1 can kidney beans, drained
1 can diced tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt

Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic. Add everything else and simmer for 30 minutes. Top with cheddar and green onions. Freezes well for up to 3 months.
